whoItsFor: Developers who want to self-host or build on a personal agent app with a browser, terminal, and file tools. It is alpha software, so it suits people comfortable configuring model keys, CopilotKit Intelligence, and optional Google OAuth.
useCases: Research public web pages in a persistent browser and summarize the results
Turn an email attachment into a filled PDF form and a reviewed reply
Track public pages for changes or USD price thresholds with alerts
